scripts.input_contract: Finite OHLC with timezone-aware increasing bar-open index; completed bars only, optional as_of enforces availability. Minimum tick is explicit. Config validates source input ranges. Session boundaries must align to chart bars.
scripts.availability_contract: All state/events are emitted at completed-bar available_at. Confirmed pivots are registered with3-bar lag; graphical historical range/sweep origins never receive backfilled events. Idle detection runs only after bar_index>stat_window. All history references remain in the observed prefix.
scripts.state_contract: Source idle/accum/sweepPending/manip/dist machine; manip is resolved outside the main branch on the same bar. Impulse trim and confirmed-pivot boundaries preserved; stop ATR anchor precedes the trimmed range. Expiry precedes news-bar reset; filtered inside breaches keep range, outside breaches reset. Sweep return deadline is strict > budget and precedes inside return. HTF rejection may rearm once, refreshing expiry and blocking the repeated side.
scripts.reference_model: Distribution enters at confirmation close, stop lies beyond full sweep excursion plus anchored ATR buffer, target uses source fib extension beyond opposite range boundary. Outcomes start next bar. Both target+stop means -1R ambiguous stop; target/stop precede timeout, whose condition is strict > budget and closes at actual reference R.
scripts.statistics_contract: Target/stop/timeout, ambiguity, double-sweep and sumR update only on resolved source cycles. Closed-cycle timestamps use source bar-open time; observations remain available at bar close. All-time counters persist; timestamped buffer prunes older31-day records only on a new resolution. 24h and30d snapshots filter causally on each observed bar. Target rate/average R stay NaN until min_sample. No final-chart backfill and no claim of option-ledger performance.
scripts.external_data_contract: Optional HTF bias requires aligned exact previous-completed HTF close and EMA50 from source [1]+lookahead_on, with available_at no later than each chart bar OPEN. HTF below chart timeframe is rejected. No HTF values are inferred from complete future candles. Killzone filters use configured timezone; no volume required.
scripts.mechanical_proposal_rule: Enter on source distribution direction; exit on its reference outcome bar. Sweep alerts are exposed separately and do not invent trades. Wrapper keeps independent compression/fib grids.
scripts.port_scope: Finite historical-bar numerical/state core, source alert conditions, causal reference statistics, per-period metrics and detached state snapshot; drawing geometry and text layout omitted.
